changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: create or alter procedure [dbo].[SimpleAssetSearch] @assetTypeId int, @filter nvarchar(500), @skip int, @take int AS BEGIN select A.Uid as [value], case when len(AP.DisplayPath) > 0 then AP.DisplayPath else 'ERR:MISSING PATH SEGMENTS' end as [label] from Asset A inner join dbo.AssetPath AP ON Ap.ID = A.ID where A.AssetTypeID = @assetTypeID and AP.DisplayPath like @filter order by AP.DisplayPath asc offset @skip rows fetch next @take rows only END
changeSet.rollback: create or alter procedure [dbo].[SimpleAssetSearch] @assetTypeId int, @filter nvarchar(500), @skip int, @take int AS BEGIN select Uid as [value], case when len(DisplayPath) > 0 then DisplayPath else 'ERR:MISSING PATH SEGMENTS' end as [label] from graph.AssetNode where AssetTypeID = @assetTypeID and DisplayPath like @filter order by DisplayPath asc offset @skip rows fetch next @take rows only END
